text: Annex 5. Summary of unpublished studies (PICO 10) 235 Fig. A5.3. PRISMA flow diagram of screening Records identified from: All Databases (n = 10 491) Embase (n = 3782) Global Health Library (n = 3602) PubMed (n = 2463) TRIP (n = 644) Cochrane CENTRAL (n = 191) Records screened (n = 7084) Reports sought for retrieval (n = 47) Reports assessed for eligibility (n = 28) Studies included in review (n = 16) Identification Screening Included Identification of studies via databases and registers Records removed before screening: Duplicate records removed (n = 3598) Records excluded (n = 7037) Peer-Reviewed Reports not retrieved/only conference abstracts or protocols published Reports excluded: Not Specific to MDR-TB (n = 4) Unrelated to review objectives/outcomes of interest (n = 7) No RCTs were found. All the studies included were observational, and no studies of resource requirements, feasibility or impact on equity were found. Four of the 16 studies included efficacy: one with MFX or ofloxacin (OFX) monotherapy, two with Lfx or MFX with a companion drug (ETH, EMB or PZA and one with standard INH therapy. Five studies reported on safety outcomes, four of which were of children and adolescents and one of adult contacts. Six studies reported the acceptability of FQ-based TPT; five reported quantitative measures and one the qualitative acceptability of a novel paediatric Lfx formulation to caregivers and child contacts. One study evaluated the global cost-effectiveness of providing Lfx to HHCs < 15 years. The studies included were too disparate to allow any pooling of results or meta-analyses. Therefore, the results below reflect non-pooled findings. The protocol of this systematic review was registered on Prospero on 23 September 2023 (ID: CRD42023462793).
